proposer.intro: Have a game idea, found a bug, or want something changed? Write it here. Every request is read by an AI, then by the site team. We can't reply to every message, but good ideas become games!
proposer.prudence: Don't write your name, address, email or phone number. If you are under 15, ask a parent to help you.
proposer.type: What would you like to do?
proposer.exemple: Explain your idea or the problem in a few sentences…
proposer.exemple.nouveau: What you do in the game, how you win, what makes it fun…
proposer.exemple.bug: What doesn't work, when it happens (level, screen), on which device…
proposer.exemple.modification: What you would like to change in this game, and why…
proposer.merci: Thank you! Your request has arrived. It will be read by an AI, then by the site team.

cookies.texte: This site uses technical data that it needs so you can play. With your consent, Google Analytics counts visits and games played (statistics), and Google AdSense may set cookies to show a non-personalised ad (never targeted). Rejecting doesn't stop you from playing. If you are under 15, ask a parent to choose.
